entries.title: A change that leaves a batch Bitbucket is still merging no longer slips into that merge
entries.body: When a change loses its approval, or its commit words change, while Bitbucket still shows its batch's merge as running, the app now declines that pull request and opens a new one with the changes that remain and any approved meanwhile. Before, the next pass put a new version on the waiting pull request, and a merge that finished late could take it before its checks ran.
entries.noPicture: This changes which pull request a batch's changes go on, not how any view looks.
